import ast
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
target,testfile,wheel=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
sys.path.insert(0,str(target))
from lingshu.world.reconstruct import keyframes
assert Path(keyframes.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(target.resolve())
# Run the committed test bodies without adding pytest to the reused clean deps.
tree=ast.parse(testfile.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
body=[]
for node in tree.body:
    if isinstance(node,ast.Import) and any(alias.name=='pytest' for alias in node.names):
        continue
    if isinstance(node,ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.value,ast.Call):
        call=node.value.func
        if isinstance(call,ast.Attribute) and isinstance(call.value,ast.Name) and call.value.id=='pytest':
            continue
    if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
        node.decorator_list=[]
    body.append(node)
tree.body=body
ast.fix_missing_locations(tree)
ns={'__name__':'installed_auto_keyframe_regressions','__file__':str(testfile)}
exec(compile(tree,str(testfile),'exec'),ns)
cases=[
 ('duplicate-view-selection',lambda:ns['test_repeating_same_view_features_preserves_selection_ratios_and_raw_tracks']()),
 ('same-tile-repeat-support',lambda:ns['test_repeated_same_view_does_not_create_independent_repeat_support']((10.,10.))),
 ('cross-tile-repeat-support',lambda:ns['test_repeated_same_view_does_not_create_independent_repeat_support']((90.,90.))),
 ('local-track-identity',lambda:ns['test_local_track_ratio_is_not_weighted_by_repeated_features']()),
 ('per-track-tile-support-and-order',lambda:ns['test_cross_tile_features_retain_each_track_tile_without_an_arbitrary_pixel']()),
 ('depth-median-duplicate-weight',lambda:ns['test_repeated_features_do_not_reweight_the_camera_depth_median']()),
 ('all-early-return',lambda:ns['test_all_and_small_inputs_return_before_inspecting_tracks'](5,True,'all')),
 ('small-early-return',lambda:ns['test_all_and_small_inputs_return_before_inspecting_tracks'](4,False,'coverage')),
]
results=[]
for name,case in cases:
    case()
    results.append(dict(name=name,status='passed'))
origins={}
for name,item in sorted(sys.modules.items()):
    if name=='lingshu' or name.startswith('lingshu.'):
        origin=Path(item.__file__).resolve()
        assert origin.is_relative_to(target.resolve()),(name,str(origin))
        origins[name]=str(origin)
distribution,=list(importlib.metadata.distributions(path=[str(target)]))
direct=json.loads(distribution.read_text('direct_url.json'))
assert direct['url'].lower().endswith('.whl') and not direct.get('dir_info',{}).get('editable',False)
result=dict(status='passed',case_count=len(results),cases=results,installed_module=keyframes.__file__,
            imported_origins=origins,noneditable=True,reused_existing_dependency_environment=True,
            fresh_venv=False,pytest_installed_for_this_check=False,direct_url=direct)
print(json.dumps(result))
